commits.message: The terminal identifies itself: askTerminalIdentity asks XTVERSION and raises what the env inferred to identified; tmux answers for itself, so no passthrough-wrapped probe is sent (tmux#5530); painters read features from their console; a replay host answers recorded probe sessions (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.zgr)

Clipboard, pointer and notification chosen by pick over the console's TerminalFeatures (6ch.a28) (#599)

* Review: a tmux or screen pane's TERM names no terminal past it; declaring an encoding keeps the inferred terminal; bell and title are pick rows; docs say no policy passes an unconfirmed layer (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.a28)

* Review: a terminal's own notification and progress cannot cross zellij or an editor (OUTER_ONLY); a bare number in OSC 9 is kept off ConEmu's shape (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.a28)
